selection: Highest estimated NUTS minimum ESS per setup-inclusive second in 1000-draw pilots; lowest projected VBM likelihood batch cost including worker setup. These pilots choose execution layouts, not the final inference result. Main comparison uses separate noise seeds 43-45.

cpu_configuration.scope: One method at a time on the same CPU host. No CPU affinity is imposed. CPU seconds sum user and system time over threads and completed worker/compiler processes; CPU seconds / wall seconds is average CPU utilization, not a core-count limit.

candidates.scope: Execution calibration on a separate noise realization; provisional short-run ESS is not the final converged benchmark.
